title: The Salt Lantern

tracked_npcs.name: Maris Thorne
tracked_npcs.goal: Keep the stolen lens hidden until the fog lifts, then decide whom to sell it to.

tracked_npcs.name: Corwen Pike
tracked_npcs.goal: Keep the council from learning that the harbor fund is empty.

world_rules: No boat may leave the harbor while the harbor bell is ringing in fog.
The Salt Lantern is a unique object: it cannot be copied or replaced during the story.

opening.scene: The Storm Festival fills the Saltmere quay with lantern smoke and fiddle music. Paper boats drift on the black water, each carrying a wish for the sea. Tamsin Reed presses the oars of the Dunlin into your hands: the last ferry back from the festival leaves in a few minutes, and the harbor bell is already tolling for the fog. Above the town, the Gull Tower stands white against the dusk, and the Salt Lantern burns steady and green.
